label: 2021 Men's South American Volleyball Championship - 34th edition
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-4 (PLAN-VB + CENSUS-VB-4), Director-approved 6-edition batch commit. Capture: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw); official match count == built count; FIDELITY per-team pool points recomputed == printed standings spw/spl (deviations, if any, proven arithmetically and disclosed); spine/table-top asserts exact. 34th edition, Brasilia, 1-5 Sep 2021, single round-robin of 5 (10 matches == C(5,2)); VENEZUELA WITHDREW pre-tournament over COVID-19 issues (ge.globo ref byte-cited) and matches were played BEHIND CLOSED DOORS (voleysur ref byte-cited). Champions BRAZIL 33rd title, undefeated (MVP + best setter Bruno Rezende); Argentina silver; BRA+ARG qualified for WCh-2022 (in store). Sources: official voleysur.org per-match result pages (unique IDjogo). FIDELITY CATCH #5 OF THE WO: printed standings disagree with the COL-PER match row by exactly ONE POINT (PER spw 237/COL spl 324 printed vs 238/325 recomputed) - both computations internally consistent, so this is a row-vs-table conflict, resolved by per-match-source precedence (the row carries the official voleysur link); both values documented.
